initial_prompt: What is the boiling point of ethanol?

messages.content: What is the boiling point of ethanol?

**78.37 °C (173.1 °F)** at standard atmospheric pressure (1 atm).

**Forward Link:**
If you are separating ethanol from water, note that they form an **azeotrope at ~95.6% ethanol**. You cannot exceed this purity using standard distillation; you will need to add an entrainer (like benzene) or use molecular sieves to achieve 100% (absolute) ethanol.
